give.symptom: A gearling reached the wheel and jammed it. The wheel has stopped, and every pusher with it.
give.fix: Dig a pit in their way, between where they come in and the wheel.

take.symptom: A gearling reached the wheel and jammed it. The wheel has stopped, and every pusher with it.

give.symptom: A gearling reached the wheel and jammed it. The wheel has stopped, and every pusher with it.
give.fix: Gearlings in other rows walk round the pit. Fences turn them toward the wheel's row, so a line of fences can send every row into one pit.

take.symptom: A gearling reached the wheel and jammed it. The wheel has stopped, and every pusher with it.

give.symptom: The pit is full. 5 gearlings are waiting behind the one in it.
give.fix: A stopped gearling stays in the pit. A pusher right beside the pit, in line with it, shoves it on so the next one can come.

take.symptom: Every gearling is broken for its springs.
take.fix: None of these come back tomorrow, and the Custodian will not speak to you today. Switch to Give to keep them coming.

give.symptom: Every gearling goes through the pit, and walks home.
give.fix: Nothing is holding it back. Six a day is all that live near this wheel. A second running machine draws more.

give.symptom: A gearling walked straight across the pit and into the wheel. The wheel has stopped.
give.fix: A gearling only stops where it is dark. Move the lamp so its light does not reach the pit.

give.fix: Your window lights the blocks round it, and so does every lamp. Plant where it is dark.

give.symptom: Every field is on the ditch.
give.fix: The ditch reaches one row. To go further: a wheel in the stream, a shaft, a sprinkler.

give.symptom: Every field is wet and every sprinkler turns.
give.fix: The blocks under the shafts grow nothing. Where you run a shaft is where the field is not.

give.symptom: Short of power: 4 made, 6 asked for. Everything runs at 67%.
give.fix: Add a second wheel, or move one to the top, where the water drops and a wheel makes 6.
